collection_method: Cloud browser ordinary rendered accessibility-tree inspection; visible sort control selected. No hidden endpoints, authenticated requests, video downloads, or pagination.

scope.login_state: Logged out; login and signup controls shown
scope.sampling_rule: First 10 named video-game categories encountered in rendered order, excluding event and non-video-game category cards. Not a complete or random platform sample.
scope.sample_position_definition: 1-based position within these selected 10 records; not an official category rank.

supports: Comparison of displayed Twitch live viewing interest within this bounded snapshot
Future like-for-like time-series comparisons keyed by source_category_url
does_not_support: Growth or trend claims from a single snapshot
Unique viewers, total players, sales, revenue, or cross-platform popularity
Gameplay, release date, or streamer concentration claims
future_comparison_requirements: Repeat same source, sort, scope and measurement semantics with timestamps
Treat absent categories as not sampled, never zero
Account for approximate rounded display, time-of-day, major events and limited sample coverage
Do not sum or equate Twitch viewers with Steam players

caveats: Single point-in-time observational sample, not a hot-game verdict.
Live metrics may update between page load and read; observed_at is capture completion time.
All 10 captured values use abbreviated 万 notation and are approximate.
Page displays no numeric category rank; category_rank is null.
Category labels and links are recorded as shown, without external game-identity or gameplay verification.
The all-categories page includes non-game and event cards; exclusions above were applied by the collector.
